$comment: MACHINE IDENTITY — local only. NEVER commit this file. NEVER sync it.
Copy to ~/.config/opencode/machine.json and edit, or run install.py --init.
This file is the ONLY place machine-specific values belong: paths, keys,
model choices, and which harnesses this machine is allowed to run.
data_root: absolute path to the participant/PII data root, OUTSIDE every repo.
Set to null on machines that must never hold such data (e.g. hague).
When null, install.py drops the ${data_root} read-deny entirely and
the analysis/writing harnesses should be listed in disable_harnesses.
disable_harnesses: harnesses NOT permitted on this machine. Emitted as
agent.<name>.disable = true, a documented OpenCode field.
